name: Hole Survivor : Isla Caliente
source: Compete for immunity, build alliances, and navigate desire in an uncensored adult reality-show strategy game. Sixteen castaways share one island, but staying wanted is how you stay in. At council, the relationships you built can decide whether you survive the night.
